usage: The word 外國 (ngoi6 gwok3) is used to refer to any country other than one's own.
It is typically used as a noun to indicate foreign countries in general or specific foreign countries mentioned in conversation.
You can combine 外國 with other words to form compound phrases like 外國人 (foreign person) or 外國文化 (foreign culture).
When talking about traveling or studying abroad, 外國 is often used to specify the destination or origin is outside your home country.
In sentences, 外國 usually functions as the subject or object and does not change form.
